fb400759-63ed-568a-b94e-5f0c2fe94b67.content: HCI reviewers find it difficult to assess the reproducibility of results if the prototype version used in the evaluation is not disclosed.

e52e8470-6419-5306-9ddd-00a86003dcf3.content: Record the manipulated and fixed elements of compared design alternatives so that other researchers can reconstruct them.

8f4edf8c-491d-56fe-bde4-d9ce25d6de50.content: Records of formative evaluation decisions enable the reconstruction of connections between raw data, interpretation, and design modifications.

87662a7e-ffc7-521a-a06c-7db8184377e8.content: The user must make it possible to trace which observations each prototype version reflects so the process of deriving design knowledge can be reviewed.
